An '''Immigration officer''' had the job of knowing who entered or left a certain area. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Atril Neff]] of the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] was an immigration officer in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].
